I was fat at 38. Now I have six pack abs at 41. Here's the 10 exercises I did every week to get here, and how to do each one right.

Here's how my workouts work. I train first thing in the morning, seven days a week. Every workout is total body. 15 minutes of cardio, then one leg exercise, three upper body exercises, and one ab exercise. I rotate through these 10 over the week, so it's not all 10 every workout. I do three sets of each exercise. One light warm-up set of 12 to 15 reps, then two working sets of 6 to 10 reps with the most weight I can lift.

The 10 exercises are cable crunches, leg press, hamstring curls, the glute bridge machine, side laterals, pull-ups, T-bar rows, chest flies, cable curls, and tricep pushdowns. I show you proper form on every one.
